explanation: At the 2008 Beijing Olympics he had run 9.69 seconds. A year later, at the World Championships in Berlin, he took 0.11 seconds off, averaging over 37 km/h (23 mph).

claims.text: Usain Bolt set the 100 m world record of 9.58 seconds at the World Championships in Berlin on 16 August 2009.
Bolt's time of 9.58 seconds was not run in 2008, 2012 or 2016.
Bolt won the 2008 Olympic 100 m in Beijing in 9.69 seconds.
9.69 seconds minus 9.58 seconds is 0.11 seconds, and 100 m in 9.58 seconds is an average speed of about 37.6 km/h (about 23.3 mph).
